summary: Edit the Default and Minimal execution environments under Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Execution Environments to use private hub image paths (for example automationhub.example.org/ee-supported-rhel9:latest) with the registry credential, then test with a job template.
questions: How do I point the default execution environment at my private automation hub?
Change the image of the Minimal execution environment
How do I verify controller can pull images from private hub?
